name: Elowen
source:
The mysterious beauty who appears before Cassidy one day. While at a glance she is graceful and beautiful in an otherworldly way, she is also quick to anger and rather self-centered. Sometimes, she becomes quiet and a little gloomy when staring out at the woods outside the cottage windows...

[From [url=https://vnstudioelan.com/bellhouse/without-a-voice/]official website[/url]]
